task.description:
WF-02 Step 03 (TEST-DESIGNER) for SOL-01/02/03.

Produce integration test specs and test files covering all MUST acceptance criteria.

1. Write test spec: tests/specs/sol-01-03-solution-pack.md
   - Document test cases for each AC of SOL-01/02/03
   - Include: test ID, AC reference, setup, action, assertion

2. Write integration test files:
   - tests/integration/sol01_export_test.zig — SOL-01 export tests
   - tests/integration/sol02_install_test.zig — SOL-02 install tests (happy path, conflict, reuse, role checklist)
   - tests/integration/sol03_role_gate_test.zig — SOL-03 activation gate tests

3. Wire tests into build.zig:
   - test-integration-sol01, test-integration-sol02, test-integration-sol03 targets

Requirements:
- All tests must use TestHarness.newUuid() or similar — NO hardcoded UUIDs
- All tests must have defer cleanup blocks for DB isolation
- No error.SkipZigTest on MUST tests
- Tests must compile cleanly: zig build test (exit 0 unit tests)

Environment: BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5434/bpm_test

Validation:
1. zig build (exits 0)
2. python tools/lint_handoffs.py (exits 0)
3. python tools/lint_test_isolation.py tests/integration (exits 0 or PASS)

Commit and push when done.
acceptance_criteria: tests/integration/sol01_export_test.zig created with SOL-01 MUST ACs covered
tests/integration/sol02_install_test.zig created with SOL-02 MUST ACs covered
tests/integration/sol03_role_gate_test.zig created with SOL-03 MUST ACs covered
